cues.trigger: Mission start — player view fades in on the impound gantry at night
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: There she is, Lodestar. Skarn-class, thirty-five tons, mothballed under a tarp and two years of gull mess. The Directorate impounded her — tonight we un-impound her.

cues.trigger: Opening beat — Ekene sets the stakes
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Listen well. The Compact has exactly no mechs. In ten minutes we'll have one. Everything we do after tonight starts with you reaching that cockpit.

cues.trigger: Player approaches the Skarn's boarding ladder
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Gantry patrols cycle every four minutes. Climb quiet — quiet-ish. It's a ten-meter ladder, do your best.

cues.trigger: Player enters the cockpit
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: You're in. Master bus is on your left — the big ugly lever. The Directorate never changed the locks. Cheap of them. Lucky for us.

cues.trigger: Cold-start sequence begins, systems flickering awake
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Unregistered pilot. Authorization matrix... absent. Overriding. Welcome aboard.

cues.trigger: Reactor catches — full startup litany plays
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

cues.trigger: Immediately after the startup litany
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Hear that hum? That's the sound of the Compact getting back up off its knees. Now walk her out.

cues.trigger: Throttle tutorial prompt appears
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Throttle up gently. This is thirty-five tons of borrowed mech; the ground takes payment in vibration.

cues.trigger: Player takes their first steps out of the gantry cradle
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: And she walks! Every seismograph on the coast just noticed. Keep moving.

cues.trigger: Leg-steering tutorial prompt appears
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Leg steering active. Your torso aims independently of your feet. This distinction will save your life.

cues.trigger: Torso-twist tutorial prompt appears
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Legs take you where you're going. Torso points where you're killing. Learn to walk one way and watch another.

cues.trigger: Player recenters torso with C for the first time
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Torso recentered. Use this after checking your flanks. Disorientation kills more pilots than lasers.

cues.trigger: Player reaches the yard's perimeter gate
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Straight through the gate — don't be gentle, it's their gate.

cues.trigger: Yard-wide alarm triggers after the gate falls
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Aaand that's the alarm. Yard security waking up. Drones first — they're cheap and they know it.

cues.trigger: First drone contacts appear on radar
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Weapons free, Lodestar. First fight in a Compact mech. Make it a lesson — for them.

cues.trigger: Weapon-groups tutorial prompt appears
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Weapon groups configured. Group one: autocannon. Group two: laser. Group three: rockets. Fire what the moment asks for.

cues.trigger: First drone destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Drone down! You've officially cost the Directorate money. Feels good, doesn't it.

cues.trigger: Player's first kill of the mission, any target
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Good. Clean and calm. That's how we'll take this whole planet back.

cues.trigger: New objective — destroy the yard tracking mast
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Priority target's up: the yard's tracking mast. That thing logs every hull that moves on Breaker Coast. It dies tonight or we never move again.

cues.trigger: Ekene reinforces the mast objective
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: As long as that mast stands, the Directorate sees every barge, skiff, and mech we'll ever launch. Bring it down and we go dark to them.

cues.trigger: Player passes the yard loudspeakers halfway to the mast
cues.speaker: Kryce
cues.line: Citizens of the coast: curfew remains in effect for your safety. The Directorate thanks you for your continued cooperation.

cues.trigger: Security mech powers up near the mast
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Contact — light mech at the mast, powering up. Yard security actually earning their pay for once.

cues.trigger: Target-lock tutorial prompt appears
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Target designated. Locked contacts display range, heading, and damage state. Knowledge first. Then violence.

cues.trigger: Player takes significant fire for the first time
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: You're hit — that's what armor's for. Keep your feet moving and your torso on them.

cues.trigger: Player heat rises above 60% for the first time
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Heat climbing. A full lesson awaits you later. For now: pause between volleys.

cues.trigger: Security mech destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Mech down! First mech kill for the Free Veyran Compact. I'm noting the date.

cues.trigger: Tracking mast enters visual range
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: There's your mast — the tall lattice with the dish cluster. Subtle, right? Put everything into the base.

cues.trigger: Tracking mast at 50% integrity
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Structural failure progressing. Continue fire.

cues.trigger: Tracking mast destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Mast is DOWN — repeat, down! Their whole coastal picture just went white. Beautiful static everywhere!

cues.trigger: Ekene reacts to the mast falling
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: That's the Directorate blind on Breaker Coast. Now they know we exist. Let's make sure they regret learning it.

cues.trigger: Exfiltration objective becomes active
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Exfil marker's live — the old slipway road. Reinforcements are inbound from the depot, so jog.

cues.trigger: Directorate hover skiffs spotted during exfiltration
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Two hover skiffs sweeping the shore road. Avoid or delete — pilot's choice.

cues.trigger: Player strays far off the exfiltration route
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Scenic route's mined, by the way. Marker. Follow it. Please.

cues.trigger: Player reaches the exfiltration point
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: You made it. One stolen Skarn, one blind enemy, zero Compact losses. Best night this coast has had in eighteen months.

cues.trigger: Mission complete — screen begins to fade
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Mission log recorded. Chassis registry updated: property of the Free Veyran Compact. I find the new designation agreeable.

cues.trigger: Mission start — pre-dawn among the beached hull carcasses, startup litany
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

cues.trigger: Opening brief after the litany
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Tide's out for six hours — the flats are open and the wrecks give cover. A Directorate patrol runs the causeway at dawn like clockwork. We're the clock breaking.

cues.trigger: Ekene frames the ambush doctrine
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: This is an ambush, Lodestar. Ambushes are patience with a trigger. Get in position and become part of the scenery.

cues.trigger: Player moves between the beached hulls
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: These hulls were ships my grandfather broke for a living. Now they're cover. The coast provides.

cues.trigger: Player reaches the marked ambush position
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Good position. Power to minimum, torso on the causeway, and wait. They'll come to us.

cues.trigger: Patrol column appears on the causeway
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Contacts — patrol column, three vehicles and a light mech escort, right on schedule. Directorate punctuality: their one virtue.

cues.trigger: Patrol nears the kill zone while the player holds fire
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Not yet. Let them get fat and comfortable in the kill zone.

cues.trigger: Conditional — player opens fire before the order
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Early! Fine — no plan survives. Hit them hard before they spread!

cues.trigger: Ambush is sprung on Ekene's command
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: NOW, Lodestar! All guns!

cues.trigger: First sustained volley — heat tutorial begins
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Observe your heat gauge. Every weapon deposits heat; your sinks drain it. Fire in rhythm, not in panic.

cues.trigger: Player heat exceeds 75% for the first time this mission
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Heat at three quarters. This is the discipline the Commander mentioned.

cues.trigger: Ekene reinforces heat discipline mid-fight
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Watch that gauge like it's your pulse. Because it is.

cues.trigger: Subtargeting tutorial unlocks
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Subtargeting online. Cycle components: weapons, legs, cockpit. Aim at what you want them to lose.

cues.trigger: Player subtargets an enemy leg for the first time
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Good — take the legs. A mech on the ground is a mech in our workshop tomorrow.

cues.trigger: First enemy component destroyed via subtargeting
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Component destroyed. Precision is economy.

cues.trigger: First enemy mech killed by legging
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: That's a salvage kill, Lodestar. Legged and helpless. The Compact thanks you twice.

cues.trigger: Patrol escort mech destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Escort's down! The column's got no teeth now.

cues.trigger: All first-patrol hostiles destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Causeway's clear. Nice ambush, everyone. Textbook — if we had textbooks.

cues.trigger: Salvage tutorial begins over the fresh wrecks
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Now the good part. Walk to a wreck and tag it — recovery crews do the rest. Kill condition sets the yield: legged and headshot pay best, ammo explosions pay in confetti.

cues.trigger: Player tags their first wreck
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Salvage tagged. Recovery yield: substantial. Your kill method preserved the chassis.

cues.trigger: Ekene delivers the salvage-economy beat
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Everything we shoot, we own — if we shoot it right. This war will be won in the workshop as much as the field.

cues.trigger: Unplanned second patrol detected inbound
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Ah. Problem. Second patrol inbound, off-schedule — someone missed a check-in. No ambush this time; they know something's wrong.

cues.trigger: Ekene resets the plan for a straight fight
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Straight fight, then. Use the wrecks, watch your heat, and pick them apart piece by piece.

cues.trigger: Second patrol opens fire into the hulks
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: They're shooting at shadows in the hulls. Be a shadow with an autocannon.

cues.trigger: Conditional — player heat hits redline during the second fight
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Redline. Shutdown imminent. This is the lesson, Lodestar.

cues.trigger: Conditional — player shuts down mid-fight
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Lodestar's dark! It happens to everyone once. Survive it and it never happens again.

cues.trigger: Conditional — player restarts after the shutdown
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Restart complete. Consider what the gauge was telling you.

cues.trigger: Tide timer begins — water returning across the flats
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Tide's turning — water's coming back over the flats. Fights slow, mechs sink. Finish this before we all learn to swim.

cues.trigger: Rising water reaches the player's position
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Water at knee actuators. Footing degraded. Mind your stride.

cues.trigger: Last second-patrol enemy destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Clear! All hostiles down, and the tide can have what's left.

cues.trigger: Final salvage sweep before the water covers the wrecks
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Tag what you can before it drowns — the quartermaster says every tonne counts, and he counts loudly.

cues.trigger: Optional — player tags every available wreck
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Full sweep. Outstanding. That's next month's armor lying on that beach.

cues.trigger: Mission complete
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Two patrols gone and the Directorate still doesn't know our faces. Next we get our people off this coast. Rest — tomorrow we go loud.

cues.trigger: Mission end log as the screen fades
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Mission log recorded. Salvage manifest transmitted. The arithmetic of this war has improved.

cues.trigger: Mission start — dawn at the slipway, startup litany
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

cues.trigger: Opening brief — Ekene sets the stakes
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Everything the Compact owns is on that dropbarge — people, parts, and the future. It launches in twelve minutes. Nothing crosses that slipway until it's gone.

cues.trigger: Launch clock goes live
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Launch clock is running. Twelve minutes of fuel, pumps, and prayer. The Directorate will hear the engines the second they light.

cues.trigger: Sable is introduced to the fireteam
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: You're not alone today. Riva Chen, callsign Sable — best long gun on the coast. Sable, meet Lodestar.

cues.trigger: Sable's first words on the net
cues.speaker: Sable
cues.line: Copy. I'm on the crane. Won't miss.

cues.trigger: Fireteam command tutorial begins
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Fireteam uplink active. Command rose: form up, attack my target, hold position, move to. Your squad extends your reach. Use them.

cues.trigger: Tutorial — player prompted to issue Attack My Target
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Try it now — designate a target and pass it to Sable. Command is a weapon. Learn its trigger.

cues.trigger: Sable acknowledges the player's first order
cues.speaker: Sable
cues.line: Marked. Watch.

cues.trigger: First wave enters through the north yard gate
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Contacts! Infantry carriers and drones through the north gate — they got here fast. First wave's the probe; don't waste ammo showing off.

cues.trigger: Sable's first kill — a long-range cockpit shot
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Did — did everyone see that? Four hundred meters, through the visor slit. I'm suddenly very glad she's on our side.

cues.trigger: Sable comments on her own shot
cues.speaker: Sable
cues.line: One.

cues.trigger: First wave cleared
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Wave one's done. Barge is at a quarter charge. They'll come heavier next.

cues.trigger: Dropbarge status reaches 25%
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Pumps at twenty-five percent. The engineers say stop letting things explode near the fuel lines. Direct quote.

cues.trigger: First gun skiff appears offshore
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Gun skiff off the point — it can shell the slipway from the water! That's a priority, Lodestar!

cues.trigger: Ekene emphasizes the skiff threat
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: That skiff outranges everything the barge has. Kill it or the launch dies at the dock.

cues.trigger: Player engages the first gun skiff
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Hover skiff: light hull, heavy gun. Lead your ballistic fire. It will not stand still.

cues.trigger: First gun skiff destroyed
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Skiff's swimming — poorly! Splash one!

cues.trigger: Second wave — light mechs advance up the beach road
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Second wave: two light mechs coming up the beach road. They've stopped probing. This is the real push.

cues.trigger: Sable calls target splits for the second wave
cues.speaker: Sable
cues.line: Left one's mine. Yours has the rockets.

cues.trigger: Player heat runs high mid-battle
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Heat elevated. The barge needs you functional more than it needs you furious.

cues.trigger: Dropbarge status reaches 50%
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Halfway! Fuel's flowing, everything's fine, nothing is on fire that shouldn't be.

cues.trigger: Dropbarge takes a direct artillery hit
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: The barge is HIT — hull's holding, but another one like that and we're walking to orbit!

cues.trigger: Ekene steadies the defense after the barge is hit
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Eyes out, not back. Protect the water line and the gate, and that barge will finish its own countdown.

cues.trigger: Second wave cleared
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Second wave broken. Good shooting, both of you.

cues.trigger: Second gun skiff appears on the southern approach
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Second skiff, southern approach — they learn! Same job, Lodestar!

cues.trigger: Second gun skiff destroyed
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Skiff down. The water's ours. Now hold the land.

cues.trigger: Dropbarge status reaches 75%
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Seventy-five percent. Engines warming. It's starting to sound like a launch out there.

cues.trigger: Final wave — Halite-class heavy brawler on the mole
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Big contact — Halite-class brawler on the mole, with friends. Forty-five tons of bad news. Wave three is everything they've got left.

cues.trigger: Sable coordinates against the Halite
cues.speaker: Sable
cues.line: I'll take its knee. You take everything else.

cues.trigger: Halite-class heavy destroyed
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Heavy's down! That's the last iron they had on this coast!

cues.trigger: Launch countdown begins — thirty seconds
cues.speaker: Relay
cues.line: Launch sequence! Thirty seconds! Clear the blast radius unless you enjoy being weather!

cues.trigger: Dropbarge lifts off — hero moment
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: There she goes. Everything we are, going up on a pillar of fire. Look at it, Lodestar. Remember it. That's what we're fighting for.

cues.trigger: Kryce's first direct broadcast to the Compact
cues.speaker: Kryce
cues.line: To the vandals of Breaker Coast: the Directorate acknowledges your little theft. Enjoy the barge. Assets are replaceable. Order is not. We will be collecting both.

cues.trigger: Ekene answers the broadcast
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Let him talk. Talk is what men do when their skiffs are on the seabed. Fireteam — we're done here.

cues.trigger: Mission complete — operation wrap-up
cues.speaker: Ekene
cues.line: Operation Breaker Coast is closed. Next stop: the Halite Flats. Long sightlines, no cover, and a convoy with our name on it. Rest up.

cues.trigger: Mission end log as the screen fades
cues.speaker: CAIRN
cues.line: Mission log recorded. Dropbarge trajectory nominal. Fireteam roster updated: Sable. I have added her accuracy to my planning assumptions.
